title: Dropzone preview
description: A compact import well opens into an actual local image preview.
useCase: Confirm an image selection and expose useful errors before any upload.
interaction: Drop a PNG, JPG or WebP, or choose one; replace or remove it.
reducedMotion: Drop emphasis and illustration settle immediately; local selection and decoding remain functional.
limitations: Local preview only; accepts raster MIME types up to 5 MB and does not upload or persist files.
look: Warm off-white page with a pale grey-green dashed drop well, a small two-card upload illustration, a white outlined button and grey helper text.
motion: Dragging a file over the well turns its dashed border solid teal and deepens the fill as the front paper straightens and the back one tilts away over 200 ms.
adapt: Drag emphasis is CSS keyed on `[data-drag=true]` (`.well` colours, `.papers i` and `.papers b` rotations), toggled with a `depth` counter; `take` validates type and size and creates the object URL. Replace the MIME list, size limit and copy, then add your upload.
